faq.q1: What services are included in your concierge?
faq.a1: We handle everything: professional photos, listing on Airbnb, Booking and Avito, 24/7 guest check-in, cleaning between each stay, monthly reporting and automatic transfer.
faq.q2: How much does your concierge service cost?
faq.a2: Our pricing is custom and tailored to each property. It includes all our services with no hidden fees. Contact us for a free estimate.
faq.a3: We cover Mohammedia, Mansouria, Bouznika and Benslimane. The entire coast between Mohammedia and Benslimane is within our service area.
faq.q4: How long to get my property listed?
faq.a4: Your property goes live within 48 hours after signing. We handle the photos, write the listings and set up the platforms.

faq.q1: Is your concierge service legal in Morocco?
faq.a1: Yes, 100% legal. A management contract is signed with each owner, compliant with the Moroccan legal framework.

faq.q1: How long to get my property listed for short-term rental?
faq.a1: From first contact to first guest, about one week. Your property goes live within 48h after signing.
faq.q2: How do you screen long-term tenants?
faq.a2: We verify each candidate's documents, income and references. Only reliable profiles are presented to you for approval.
faq.q3: How long does it take to sell a property?
faq.a3: It depends on the market, but our goal is to sell at the best price within a reasonable timeframe. We keep you informed at every step.
faq.q4: Can I use my property whenever I want in short-term rental?
faq.a4: Yes, you block the dates you want on the shared calendar. Your property remains yours.
